description: Check package installs with the Chainsaw install guard before Bash runs them. Without the chainsaw CLI on PATH this does nothing, and the session-start check says so. Exit status 2 is remapped to 1 so a crashed check can never block every command.

hooks.command: command -v chainsaw >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; chainsaw guard agent-hook; s=$?; [ "$s" -eq 2 ] && exit 1; exit "$s"
